comparison.trend_statement: class-11 clean mean m4 exceeds class-10 (1.65 vs 1.28), matching the QPSK<16QAM ordering, but the absolute values do not separately sit at the references (SRRC-like-only means: class-10 1.08 vs QPSK 1.00 [range 1.01-1.14], class-11 1.59 vs 16QAM 1.32 [range 1.39-1.79]); the class-10 SRRC-like frames cluster near the QPSK reference, while class-11 frames land above the 16QAM reference, consistent with low-SNR pull toward the Rayleigh value 2.0 and/or a non-QAM constellation. Partially consistent at most; exploratory only, no classification claim.
